Live fire shooting delivers an immersive combat experience that makes players feel the heroic bearing of a soldier. This system integrates competitiveness, focus, and coordination into one hyper-realistic live-fire training platform, delivering unparalleled control and a profound sense of achievement.



>> Features of Live Fire Shooting:


  • Hyper-Realistic Combat Experience: Offers lifelike shooting mechanics with accurate weapon simulation and combat scenarios.

  • Real-Time Tracking & Feedback: Features precise tracking of shots and immediate feedback for players to enhance their skills.

  • Immersive Training Modes: Multiple combat scenarios that challenge reflexes, accuracy, and strategic thinking.

  • Dynamic Situational Awareness: Real-time environmental changes and challenges that test decision-making under pressure.

  • Advanced Control System: Allows users to control their weapon and movements as if they were in a real combat situation.

  • Comprehensive Performance Metrics: Tracks various performance parameters, such as accuracy, speed, and reaction time, to help players improve.

  • Safe and Secure: Designed with safety in mind, offering an intense experience without real weaponry.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Live Fire Shooting:


Military & Tactical Training: Ideal for training soldiers and tactical teams in simulated combat scenarios.


Entertainment Venues: Perfect for creating thrilling and competitive experiences in entertainment centers or simulation arenas.


Improves Reflexes & Decision-Making: Enhances reaction time, focus, and quick decision-making abilities under pressure.

Adrenaline-Packed Entertainment: Suitable for individuals seeking a high-energy, competitive shooting experience.


No Real Ammunition Needed: Provides a completely safe, live-fire experience using advanced simulation technology.


Suitable for Group Events: Can be used for team-building exercises, competitive group training, and entertainment in group settings.



>> Product Number: LJST028


  • Floor area: 8m*1.02m*2.6m

  • Number of people: 1 person

  • Participation time: 3 minutes

  • Power: 1260w



>> FAQs for Live Fire Shooting:


Q1: Is Live Fire Shooting safe?

A1: Yes, Live Fire Shooting uses advanced simulation technology with no real ammunition, ensuring a safe experience for all participants.


Q2: What kind of weapons can be used in the system?

A2: The system is designed to simulate various types of firearms, from handguns to assault rifles, for a comprehensive shooting experience.


Q3: Can the difficulty level be adjusted?

A3: Yes, the system allows users to adjust the difficulty level, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced shooters.


Q4: What type of feedback does the system provide?

A4: It provides real-time feedback on accuracy, timing, and other performance metrics to help improve your skills.


Q5: Can this system be used for group events or training sessions?

A5: Absolutely! The system is perfect for team-building exercises, competitive events, and training sessions for groups.
